purpose: Strong-route ceiling screen on two complete SQL repair interactions. Two constructed development contracts, not a model ranking.

decision: If the requested strong route readily completes both contracts, classify as repair integration/regression evidence, not frontier headroom. A transport failure cannot establish cognitive difficulty. GLM is not scheduled in this screen; no cross-model conclusion.
